title: fix(platform-objects): the Sessions subtitle no longer says active on the revoked view
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

Part of #33551 — this PR ships the subtitle half only; the toolbar half (the "Sign out other devices" action on the revoked view) stays open on the card, see Loose ends.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:会话对象 `sys_session` 的对象描述从 "Active user sessions" 改为中性的 "User sessions",源文件与全部 11 个语言包同步(中文为「用户会话」)。
- 为什么改:控制台把对象描述当作每个列表视图的副标题,「设置 → 会话 → 已撤销」视图列出的是已结束的会话,副标题却写着「活跃的用户会话」,误导管理员。
- 风险与回滚:仅改一行展示文案,不动字段、视图、动作或权限;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-session.object.ts`(描述行与注释),`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-session-list-columns.test.ts`(新增断言)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/sys-session-list-columns.test.ts`,预期 9 个测试全部通过;或打开「设置 → 会话 → 已撤销」,副标题为「用户会话」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_session.description`: `'Active user sessions'` to `'User sessions'`. The console draws an object's description as the subtitle of every list view (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx` subtitle reads `objectDef.description`), and the seat ruling on this card keeps that console behaviour, so the fix is the metadata. A comment at the key says why it must stay neutral.
- The eleven `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles: `en` matches what the generator writes from the source (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` changed nothing after the edit); the ten translated values are hand-edited per the bundle convention (`ar`, `de`, `es-ES`, `fr`, `ja-JP`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-CN` 用户会话, `zh-Hant` 使用者工作階段). No key added or dropped. `sys_session` has no `source-hashes` entry, so no staleness record moves.
- One pin, added as a top-level `describe` in the existing `sys_session` list-view harness: the source, `en` and `zh-CN` descriptions are declared, non-empty and do not say "active".
- Changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 122 files / 1975 tests passed at a5febe68, and 122 files / 1995 tests passed at the final head c98b048d (after merging origin/main, which also touched platform-objects bundles).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` (tsc, scripts tsconfig, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Ablation (each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed by anchor count 1 to 0 and blob change, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - source back to `'Active user sessions'`: red, `sys_session description (source): expected 'Active user sessions' not to match /\bactive\b/i`.
  - `zh-CN` back to 活跃的用户会话: red, `sys_session description (zh-CN): expected '活跃的用户会话' not to match /活跃|活動|有效/`.
  - `en` back to `Active user sessions`: red, `sys_session description (en): …`.
  - Restored: 9/9 green.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance has two halves. This PR meets the subtitle half only, so it says `Part of`, not a closing keyword.
- The toolbar half has no existing mechanism to use, measured on origin/main 1e65a389:
  - The action `visible` predicate scope has only the roots `current_user`, `user`, `ctx`, `os` and `features` (`buildExpressionScope` in `ExpressionProvider.tsx`). It has no view root, so a predicate naming the view would fail closed on every view.
  - The view's `userActions.buttons` has no reader (`git grep`: 0 hits; control: `ListView.tsx` reads `userActions` 33 times). `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` records it as dead.
  - `rowActions` and `bulkActions` move only record-scoped actions off the header.
  - The page-level `buttons` list belongs to interface pages. Setup → Sessions is not one.
- Any route therefore needs a spec or ui change. See Loose ends.

## Loose ends

- **Toolbar half of #33551, carrier for the remainder:** make the declared-but-dead `userActions.buttons` the view's toolbar allowlist. The console's object-view header would then draw only the `list_toolbar` actions a view names, whenever the key is present. The spec describe is clarified (`semantic`, minor), and the `revoked` view declares `userActions: { buttons: [] }`. Four axes:
  - **Business need:** one measured consumer, this view.
  - **Long-term:** it closes an enforce-or-remove item instead of adding a key, which is declared = enforced and contract-first.
  - **AI-error:** today the Studio list-view form lets an author store the key and the runtime drops it silently; after the change the key does what it says.
  - **Startup focus:** no new key, but it is a semantic change to a published key and touches `ui/packages/app-shell`.
- **Alternatives weighed:**
  - A `view` CEL root for action predicates. Rejected: it would be bound on one surface only and fail closed everywhere else, which is a new trap and a new surface.
  - Retiring the key and accepting the action on every view. Rejected: it needs a re-ruling of the card's acceptance.

- `check-comment-mask-corpus` and `check:query-options-erasure` hit a 240 s wrapper timeout the first time. They were re-run untimed and both exited 0 (22364 files, 0 disagree; ratchet holds, none new).
- `pnpm check:i18n`: OK, 10 packages, all bundles in sync. `--write` changed nothing, so the hand-edited `en` value is byte-equal to the generator's output.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- PR-body gates: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword` all exit 0.
- Not run locally, left to CI (declared narrowing): `check:type-check-debt`, after two `os-verify-lock` queue-timeouts (exit 99) behind a holder of more than 30 minutes; and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. `--ran` therefore reports 2 UNRUN. Neither family reads a file this diff changes in a way it could move: this diff edits string literals and one test.
